scope: Primary-source method metadata for five existing records

sample.selection: Female monozygotic twins reporting prior anomalous shared experiences
sample.missingness: One second-session recording lost to equipment malfunction

sensory_conditions.description: Separate rooms about 8 m apart; both participants received synchronized 13 Hz flicker.

study_metadata.controls: Static-image control; general and personal image conditions; roles randomly assigned.
study_metadata.analysis: SSVEP-ERPC over 190 electrode pairs; 10,000 surrogate timings; temporal-autocorrelation adjustment and aggregate trinomial test reported.
limitations: Repeated condition results are not independent participants.
Selection and shared stimulation require appraisal; reported statistical corrections not independently validated.

study_metadata.design: Repeated paired EEG recordings, article version 3

sample.selection: Five men and one woman; longstanding friends with meditation/concentration experience

sensory_conditions.description: Receiver in soundproof room; synchronized headset recordings; isolation not independently verified.

study_metadata.controls: Stimulated sender compared with unstimulated receiver; randomized intervals between stimuli.
study_metadata.analysis: Conventional ERP averaging detected sender response only; new electrode-correlation method reported weak receiver signal at 9–10 Hz using bootstrap/Monte Carlo analysis.
limitations: Receiver finding depends on analysis method; reviewer reservations require appraisal.

study_metadata.design: Digitisation and reanalysis of selected published EEG traces

sensory_conditions.description: Comparisons include twins and a twin/unrelated person; original conditions not independently reconstructed.

study_metadata.analysis: Manual Engauge digitisation; Welch/multitaper spectra and magnitude-squared coherence using overlapping one-second segments.
limitations: Derived 100 Hz grid is not a verified original acquisition rate.
Selected printed traces do not represent a new cohort or complete original dataset.

study_metadata.design: Narrative mini review of social cognition and hyperscanning

sensory_conditions.description: Examples include games, music, imitation, speech and facial affect.

study_metadata.analysis: Conceptual taxonomy; no new participant-level analysis.
study_metadata.terminology: Non-local refers to operations across interacting brains sharing information; does not establish quantum nonlocality or sensory-isolated transfer.
limitations: Cited studies retain their original evidence lineages.

study_metadata.design: Dual EEG during spontaneous imitation via video

sample.exclusion_reason: Role-symmetry index more than three standard deviations from the mean

sensory_conditions.description: Participants viewed partner hand movements through video.

study_metadata.controls: Synchronized versus nonsynchronized interaction episodes; imitation contrasts.
study_metadata.analysis: Phase-locking values; cluster permutation/bootstrap maximum statistic across electrode pairs and frequency bands, reported familywise threshold 0.05.
limitations: Conventional interaction comparator; synchronization does not establish causation or sensory-isolated communication.

Selected method extraction only; no replication, correction/retraction clearance or complete statistical appraisal. Null denotes not applicable here; explicit NOT_VERIFIED statuses denote unchecked availability.
